notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list places a tower here, and it names it 'enigma?' (compiler's label; the question mark is in the list). No source we read gives a build date, height, staffing, fire or current status. The note 'firetower rd' is unexplained; the list's header and footer have no legend for the notes column. A Realtor.com land listing (not fetched in full) gives directions to 'Firetower Rd' just past Enigma on US 82, which may be the location clue, but it is not evidence about the tower. Not on the Commons 'Georgia Forestry Commission towers' category and no Enigma tower photo found. Units: the list gives no unit; 336 is read as feet, which matches the record's 102.4 m. NHLR: the Georgia page's full list of 29 names was read on 2026-10-21; none is Enigma. Access, status and visit fields stay unknown.
